name: Frame Window Counter
description: Record a run at 240 TPS, then scan every click (any gamemode, any button, P1 and P2) to count how many frames it could be shifted and still pass. Open the pause menu for Record, Replay, Analyze and Clear.

scan-range.name: Scan range
scan-range.description: How many ticks each click is shifted to each side before the scan stops and shows a plus sign. Higher is slower.

local-check.name: Local check
local-check.description: On: a shifted click passes if you are still alive a bit after the next click (fast). Off: the whole level must be completed for every trial (exact, but very slow on long levels).

check-horizon.name: Local check length
check-horizon.description: Ticks (at 240 TPS) you must stay alive after the next click for a local check to pass.

scan-budget-ms.name: Scan time per frame (ms)
scan-budget-ms.description: How long the scan may work each rendered frame. Higher scans faster but the game stutters more.

count-fps.name: Count frames at FPS
count-fps.description: 240 counts physics ticks. 120 or 60 divides the windows so a 4 tick window shows as 1 frame at 60.

counter-max.name: Counter rows
counter-max.description: Number of counter rows. The last row counts that many frames or more (for 5, the row is 5+).

show-circles.name: Show click numbers
show-circles.description: Floats each click's frame window next to the icon during replay.
